_comment: OpsRAG benchmark question schema — every question in the ~200-question BGP dataset follows this shape.

fields.category: string — one of: session-establishment | route-policy | security | mtu-path | as-path | address-family | rr-reflector | graceful-restart | multipath | addpath | bfd | confederation | communities | operational
fields.difficulty: string — one of: recall | apply | diagnose
fields.fault_id: string | null — links to thesis/lab/faults/<id>.json if this question maps to a seeded fault
fields.question: string — the plain-language question posed to the system under test
fields.context: string | null — optional network context (topology, config snippet, show output) supplied as RAG input

ground_truth.answer: string — the correct answer / root cause / fix
ground_truth.layer: string — bgp | link | tcp-auth | policy | igp | control-plane
ground_truth.commands: list[string] — the show commands an operator would run to diagnose/verify
ground_truth.executable: boolean — true if the answer can be verified by running a command against a sandbox
ground_truth.grounded_in: list[string] — RFC numbers / vendor docs that back this answer

evaluation.rag_answer_relevance: float 0-1 — filled by RAGAs at eval time
evaluation.executability: boolean | null — filled by oracle at eval time
evaluation.diagnosis_correct: boolean | null — filled by oracle at eval time

provenance.source: string — which doc / fault file this came from
